items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: That was Kid Renny's band. Oh, it was Kid Renny. Kid Renny. He played with Kid Renny.

ctx.x: Same as the Elks Club now.

That's right. He played at the Bulls and he played at the Bulls for years. And I can remember hearing him. Whose band was that? That was Kid Renny's band. Oh, it was Kid Renny. Kid Renny. He played with Kid Renny. And I can remember when I was a little kid I can remember sitting on the steps and the Bulls was about ten blocks from us. And you could hear him play at the Bulls when the wind was blowing back on Sixth Street. And he used to play parades and we used to follow him along the streets. Just like you do,…
I think so too from what I've seen too.
